per_scene.05: silhouette and dark ground within +/-0.10 EV; improve diffuse ceiling/opening only if feasible

material.fixed_spatial_sampling: phone aligned diagnostic crop and camera full frame reduced by area to edge 1024; native crops remain native
material.medium_band: log2Y box-radius2 minus box-radius8; additional radius8 minus32
material.exemption: tiny or nearly uniform ROI: record insufficient support; never score noise as recovered texture
material.noise_watch: fine increase >25% without medium gain >5% requires stage inspection; not evidence of material gain

color.method: each pixel normalized to Y=0.18 then converted to OKLab; same coordinates; valid original Y>0.02; hue only normalized chroma>0.012
color.interpretation: threshold breach triggers investigation and cannot silently count pass; when original color is demonstrably wrong, explicit new evidence required, no relaxation for candidate

edges.codec_reference: existing extended 72-case final encode/decode gate; retain its original numeric tolerances
edges.native: 9406/9416 legs plus hair, arm, white garment/dark background, pale skin/pale background; reference exact original coordinates
edges.profile_measure: both sides of contour, signed first derivative of log Y and normalized ab; plot raw and common-exposure profiles. New narrow 2-16px peaks/troughs exceeding baseline are flagged, visual evidence determines veto
edges.optical_fringe: 9450/9452 paper, 9472 leg, DSCF8130 fan known preexisting; compare Natural and RAW before attributing

split.holdout_policy: freeze ROIs from baseline; do not tune on candidate holdout outcomes. Failures trigger rejection or separately named next round with explicit loss of holdout status.

criteria.amendment_policy: retain original criteria/results and explain any necessary measurement bug correction. No candidate-driven threshold relaxation.
